doors.truthFlag: status: "success"; no paging — the widget's default arguments (start 0, end 0, incldateless true) request the organization's whole upcoming list in one response
doors.note: The URL the widget builds (widget.js: /events/events_by_organization/<pid>/<oid>/<start>/<end>/<topic>/<inclcal>/<incltopic>/<incldateless>/<inclThumbnail>/<promoterId>, served from events.ticketsauce.com). Rows are an id-keyed map under $.data; each row is an envelope { Event, EventTopic, Logo, Masthead, Organization, Photo, Partner }. Event carries name, summary/details (HTML), start/end (local wall clock) with start_utc/end_utc and timezone "America/Chicago", location (the venue name), address/city/state/postal_code, latitude/longitude, thumb_url, and url (the sickening.events event page, where tickets are sold). Every row is a dated instance; the feed states no recurrence rule (LIP SERVICE KARAOKE's weekly nights are separate rows with numbered slugs). Re-read 2026-10-17 from the scraper's cache (fetched 2026-10-16T10:18:59.355Z): 14 rows, 11 distinct titles, 2026-10-16 → 2026-11-27; the feed is upcoming-only, so the September/early-October rows of the 2026-09-19 read are gone and the window has rolled forward. Every row carries Logo.url (artwork) and latitude/longitude; the rows were regenerated from the cached body. NOTE robots.txt on events.ticketsauce.com (read from the cache) says "User-agent: * / Disallow: /events/events_by_organization" and "DisallowAITraining: /": the configured door is disallowed for every crawler; the run fetched it under the "configured source's own door, requested anyway" policy (🤖 ROBOTS log line). Owner call.
